name: NotebookLM
desc: Google's research notebook, renamed Gemini Notebook in 2026
desc_zh: Google 的资料研究笔记本，2026 年更名为 Gemini Notebook
solves: A model will invent a citation and you will not find out until someone checks. NotebookLM answers from the sources you uploaded, with every line pointing back.
solves_zh: 模型编出一个引用，往往要等别人查才发现。NotebookLM 只依据你上传的资料作答，每一句都能点回原文。
best_for: A fixed pile of papers or documents you are trying to actually get through.
best_for_zh: 当手头是一批固定的资料，而你要的是真读进去。
notes: 2026-11-25：released 2023-07-26/day → 2023-07-12/day; source https://blog.google/technology/ai/notebooklm-google-ai/。原日期 2023-07-26 没有出处。Google 官方公告（2023-07-12）：「Today we’re beginning to roll out Project Tailwind with its new name: NotebookLM, an experimental offering from Google Labs.」 2026-11-25：status active → renamed; superseded_by null → gemini-notebook。Google 官方博客（2026-07-16）：「We’re renaming NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook. It's the same standalone product」。按改名规则，旧名档案指向新名字的档案 2026-11-25：desc "Research assistant grounded in sources you upload" → "Google's research notebook, renamed Gemini Notebook in 2026"。产品已改名，摘要里写明去向 2026-11-25：desc_zh "只依据你上传的资料作答、并给出处的研究助手" → "Google 的资料研究笔记本，2026 年更名为 Gemini Notebook"。产品已改名，摘要里写明去向
